why_standardization_first: Phase 1's StandardScaler (mean 0, std 1) is reused unchanged so classical-baseline comparability and Phase 1's leakage-safe guarantees are preserved exactly.
why_additional_quantum_scaling: ZZFeatureMap encodes feature values as rotation angles, which are periodic with period 2*pi. Unbounded standardized values risk two different feature values producing indistinguishable quantum states. An additional MinMaxScaler (fit on TRAIN only) maps every standardized feature into [0, pi], safely inside a single period.
expected_range: [0, pi] for every one of the 4 selected features
where_applied: As a separate step, immediately before circuit encoding -- NOT folded into Phase 1's saved scaler, so Phase 1's pipeline and artifacts remain completely unmodified.
